# Answer: strongest generator shortcut

The strongest plausible shortcut is:

> **Apply upward gravity only when there is at least one internal full-height vertical color-8 wall; otherwise return the input unchanged.**

This shortcut fits **all 5 official canonical pairs**, because every canonical input has an internal vertical wall. That fit is executed—not inferred from prose—by `CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS["requires_vertical_wall"]`; see `checks/shortcut/ed98575459d2/evidence.json`.

## Exact separating input

This is ordinary `generate(seed=20261004, sample_index=0, difficulty=None)`, profile `single_chamber`, with observed axes `grid_h=8`, `grid_w=12`, `n_walls=0`, `n_hwalls=0`, `n_pebbles=7`:

```text
888888888888
800000000008
800000000708
806000000008
800000005008
800000000508
803000000248
888888888888
```

The shortcut has no internal vertical wall to trigger on, so it returns that input unchanged. The intended result is:

```text
888888888888
806000005748
803000000508
800000000208
800000000008
800000000008
800000000008
888888888888
```

## How the output was checked

From the packet root I ran:

```bash
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply ed98575459d2 \
  --input ../checks/shortcut/ed98575459d2/input.json \
  --out ../checks/shortcut/ed98575459d2/racket.json
```

The command exited 0. The receipt reports executed rule hash `7798fc567577` and generator SHA-256 `2dec769ef0b86be5809bb589af04b56f0786b6d5c2239b8c6ce10a069787eb06`. Its output exactly matches `rule_mirror` and differs from the shortcut output. Full input, Racket output, rival output, hashes, command, and nonzero-cell coordinates are retained in `checks/shortcut/ed98575459d2/evidence.json`.

## Does the proposed generator emit such cases?

**Yes, deliberately and ordinarily.** Profiles `single_chamber` and `horizontal_split` have `n_walls=0`, occupying 2 of every 5 schedule positions. Therefore every complete five-demo lesson contains a normal generated counterexample to the shortcut. The declaration-driven cyclic probe found no surviving shortcut in any of 20 cyclic windows, and the 300-lesson shared census refuted it in all 100 lessons per easy/medium/hard band.
